newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhenhai to up diesel, jet fuel exports.
newsitem.headline: Zhenhai to up diesel, jet fuel exports.

text.p: Zhenhai Refining & Chemical Co Ltd said it planned to increase its export of diesel and jet fuel products in the second half of the year.

"We will increase the diesel and jet fuel export in the second half in view of their high profit margin and an underlying strong demand for the products in the market," said the company's chairman Zhang Jiaren in a press briefing.
The company's executive director Chen Hong Zhan said Zhenhai produced 160,000 tonnes of jet fuel, 680,000 tonnes of diesel and 672,000 tonnes of gasoline during the six months period.

Sales of diesel, jet fuel and gasoline accounted for a respective 37.25, 7.02 and 25.28 percent of the company's total sales for the first half of 1996, compared with 35, 9.5 and 18 percent the same period a year ago.
Zhang said he expected international crude oil prices to drop in the second due to a possible increase in supply.
"We plans to process 3.08 million tonnes of crude oil in the second half and to achieve a target throughput of six million tonne for the whole year," he added.

Meanwhile, Zhang said most of the facilities under its upgrading programme will commence operation at the end of the year and it intends to initiate the third phase expansion to increase the company's comprehensive processing capacity to 16 million tonnes per annum in two stages.
"The feasibility study report in respect of the expansion has been submitted for approval to the State Planning Commission (in China)," Zhang said.

Zhang said the company intended to fund the proposed expansion by bank borrowing but he did not rule out the possibility of raising capital in the equity market in view of the company's low debt to equity ratio of 28.5 percent for the first half of 1996.
Zhenhai Refining posted an interim profit of 282.27 million yuan, up 10 percent from the same period a year ago.
